concept.title: Changing the coolant
concept.shortdesc: Have the coolant replaced by a professional workshop. Kia recommends visiting an authorized Kia dealer or service partner.

note.p: To prevent the coolant from overflowing into engine parts (such as the alternator), place a thick cloth around the radiator cap before refilling the coolant.

li.p: Do not use engine coolant or antifreeze in the washer fluid reservoir.
Radiator coolant can severely obscure visibility when sprayed on the windshield. This may cause a loss of vehicle control or damage the paint and body trim.
